name: Minimum rows in a binary strength-4 orthogonal array with 63 columns
definition: Find the smallest number N of rows in a binary orthogonal array with 63 columns and strength 4. Rows may repeat. Every selection of four columns must contain each of the 16 binary patterns exactly N/16 times.
solution_format: An object with rows: a list of integers. Each integer is a 63-bit row mask; bit j is the entry in column j.
constraints: Every row has exactly 63 binary entries encoded by an integer mask in [0,2^63).
For every set of four columns, each of the 16 binary patterns occurs exactly N/16 times.
Repeated rows are allowed and must not be rejected solely for duplication.
N is a positive multiple of 16. Rao's bound gives N >= 2032 for this configuration.
verification: The checker packs each column as an N-bit integer. For every nonempty subset of at most four columns, it counts the rows with odd parity. Every count must equal N/2. These balanced parity characters are equivalent, by binary Fourier inversion, to uniform counts for all 16 patterns on every four-column subset.

source_review.definition: Binary strength-four orthogonal arrays with 63 columns; minimize positive row count, repeated rows allowed. No linearity restriction in the checker.
source_review.primary_source: Root read Carlet, Kiss and Nagy DOI10.1007/s10623-022-01105-4, Remark5 BCH-dual reconstruction, Proposition10 and Remark11 shortened Kerdock2048 with unknown optimality. Rao2017 and divisibility16 imply2032, leaving16-row gap. Closed15-column128-row case excluded. Current same-parameter proof search found no closure.
source_review.human_method: GF64 primitive polynomial x6+x+1; all4096 linear forms on column labels(x,x3). Public2048 reported separately without reproduced witness. Human/reference4096 independently reproduced.
source_review.isolation: Root returned initial BCH construction that exposed the comparison method. Revised initializer uses generic random greedy labels in F2^14,16384 rows; baseline/evolution independently use F2^13,8192 rows. Neither reads comparison witnesses or BCH formulas.
source_review.independent_method: Root Gaussian-eliminates actual row space, proves full uniformly repeated binary linear space, and verifies rank4 of all595665 four-column projections by checking each fourth label outside the triple span. This differs from formal637392 balanced parity-character counts. Human rank12 yields256 of each pattern.
